Based on the search results, here's what I found about Jev and TypeSafe's new typesafe SDK:

## Overview

There's a new class of AI model out from TypeSafe called Jev, their flagship model. It comes from TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco lab that came out of stealth on September 15, 2026 with $40M in seed funding and Jev as its first public model.

## What is Jev?

TypeSafe's Jev is a new class of AI model, a System One Model, that returns typed decisions with calibrated probabilities instead of text, running 40-200x faster than frontier LLMs. While Jev gives up string generation, it's optimized for structured outputs and can't hallucinate. Think of Jev as a frontier-intelligence function call: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out.

## SDK Support

TypeSafe provides official SDKs for Python and JavaScript alongside the raw HTTP API. There are also community SDKs available, such as an idiomatic, type-safe Elixir port of the official TypeScript AI SDK providing unified LLM integrations, streaming text and structured outputs, tool calling, and agentic workflows.

## Question Types

There are three question primitives: choice picks one option from a set, score rates against ordered levels, and noul returns a yes/no probability between 0 and 1.

## Key Features

Every question in a request is evaluated in parallel against the same state, which means batching a dozen questions into one call costs little more than asking one. State and questions share a budget of roughly 32,000 tokens — about 150,000 characters of English text — and TypeSafe reports end-to-end response times of 70–500ms, making Jev a good fit for classification, routing, extraction, scoring, and guardrail checks on the request path.

## What is Jev?

Jev is TypeSafe AI's first "System One Model" — a frontier AI designed for fast, structured decision-making within software rather than text generation. The company describes it as a "frontier-intelligence function call: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out."

## Key Characteristics

**Speed & Cost:** Jev achieves "end-to-end response time is 70ms-500ms" and costs "$0.042 / MTok" for input tokens with "FREE" output tokens, reportedly 40x-200x faster than comparable LLMs while being significantly cheaper.

**Type Safety:** The model guarantees no type errors and cannot hallucinate, always providing calibrated confidence scores with outputs.

## Overview

Jev from TypeSafe AI is now available on AI Gateway. Jev is a probabilistic decision model for software: state goes in, typed Choice, Score, and Boolean answers come out.

## Key Features

Jev evaluates all declared questions in parallel and returns typed answers plus probabilities directly. That removes unnecessary text generation and makes it straightforward to automate clear cases while routing uncertain ones to review.

## Performance

TypeSafe reports Jev was up to 193.6x faster and 444.6x cheaper than LLMs on its workflow evaluations.

## Integration

AI SDK 7 exposes Jev through the experimental evaluate API. Call the model with typesafe-ai/jev. Jev supports Zero Data Retention and No Training, enabled per request in the example.

## Use Cases

Example use cases include: Choosing the next tool or subagent in an agent loop · Deciding whether to continue, retry, ask the user, or stop and verifying model outputs and enforcing guardrails.
